newsitem.title: GREECE: Greek inflation steadies at 8.5 pct yr/yr in Sept.
newsitem.headline: Greek inflation steadies at 8.5 pct yr/yr in Sept.

text.p: Greek consumer price inflation was unchanged at 8.5 percent year-on-year in September, a monetary source told Reuters.
Th official inflation figure is due to be released later on Friday by the National Statistics Service (NSS).

An informal poll of Greek bankers and economists produced a mean forecast of 8.5 percent for September inflation, unchanged from August. Forecasts ranged from 8.6 percent to 8.4 percent. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
